Body.Content:
Govern employee and business partner access to resources at enterprise scale with compliance and auditing controls. Azure AD entitlement management removes barriers to internal and external collaboration by automating employee and partner access requests, approvals, auditing, and review for Office 365, for thousands of popular SaaS apps or for any line of business app integrated with Azure AD.

Read the tech community blog to learn more.
